item.title: Everything Sprouts, LLC Expands Voluntarily Recall to Include Robust Radish Mix Due to Potential E. Coli and Salmonella Risk

item.description: Jaime’s Foods ATX of Austin, TEXAS is recalling Jaime’s Spanish Village Jalapeno Ranch because it contains undeclared eggs. People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to eggs run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction if they consume this product.
